name: Horticulture
overview: Scripture highlights horticulture as a God-ordained practice that involves careful stewardship and reverence for the land. The planting and harvesting of fruit trees are regulated with periods of rest and dedication to the Lord, emphasizing holiness and gratitude (Leviticus 19:23-25). Additionally, even in times of war, God commands respect for trees that provide life and sustenance, forbidding their destruction unless they are not useful for food (Deuteronomy 20:19-20). This reveals a divine principle valuing both provision and preservation within horticultural practices.
